text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm feeling a bit peckish! What 
should I eat—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an extra-spicy curry festival! Nice, 
that hits the spot for what I'm craving 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks for the food! Yeah, worked 
up a good sweat!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Both the flavor and the spice rivaled an 
authentic curry shop— it was an incredible 
dish!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can face my training 
feeling great—

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on finishing the Super 
Spicy MAX Curry, customer. That was truly 
a magnificent display of appetite.

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
By the way—we only recommend our 
ultra-super-spicy secret menu to customers 
who have completely finished this dish, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a curry even spicier than this? I 
wonder what would happen if someone 
actually ate that...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I want to try it out! Come on, 
bring it here already!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia took on an even spicier menu, 
and ended up slacking off on training.
